title: Pizza with Pepperoni (School Lunch, Thick Crust)

content.title: About
content.content: Pizza with pepperoni is a popular school‑lunch option. The dough has a thick crust, topped with slices of spicy pepperoni sausage, tomato sauce, and mozzarella cheese. It is baked in an oven, giving the crust a crunchy texture and the cheese a uniform melt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pepperoni is an American version of Italian salami, made from pork and beef seasoned with paprika and other spices.
A thick crust requires a longer baking time, resulting in a denser, more filling slice.
Pizza is often included in school menus as a source of protein and carbohydrates needed for children’s growth.
Some schools serve pizza with vegetable sides to balance the meal.
Tomato sauce contains lycopene, an antioxidant that supports heart health.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Pepperoni and cheese provide a substantial amount of protein essential for growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Mozzarella cheese supplies calcium, important for bone development in children.

items.title: Contains lycopene
items.content: The tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, an antioxidant with heart‑protective properties.

items.title: Energy‑dense
items.content: The thick crust offers lasting satiety thanks to complex carbohydrates.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dough and meat ingredients contain vitamins B1, B2, and B6, supporting metabolism.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Pepperoni and prepared sauce can be salty, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Cheese and processed meat contain saturated fats that should be limited in the diet.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Children with lactose intolerance or milk‑protein allergy should avoid this pizza.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: The thick crust makes the pizza more calorie‑rich, so portion control is advisable.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the pizza hot, cutting it into individual slices. For a more balanced meal, pair it with fresh vegetables or a salad. Optional toppings include fresh basil or oregano for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2–3 days. Reheat in an oven or microwave to keep the crust crisp.
